notes: Red's team from the anime and the old Game Boy, rebuilt from memory.
Picked Squirtle because Gary always picks the counter, so this time nobody gets the water type but me.
Bulbasaur was cute, and Zapdos was the first legendary she ever caught.
Refuses to evolve Pikachu because Ash didn't, and it gets to hold the Light Ball.
Only trained three; overlevelled the starter and hoped it was enough.
Loved bugs since Viridian Forest and stuck with them through the League.
Thinks Team Rocket had the coolest Pokemon and built a whole team of them.
Spent way too long surfing and fishing on the way to Cinnabar and this is what came of it.
First ever Pokemon game; every HM they can fit is on the team because the box is scary, and Surf lives on a boxed Psyduck.
Got the one Eevee from Celadon, wanted all three, and hatched the other two at the Daycare.
Sabrina was the best gym leader so it's all Psychic types, minus the trade she couldn't do.
Wants to be Bruno when he grows up.
Went through the Seafoam Islands three times to get Articuno in a Great Ball.
Caught Zapdos in the Power Plant and it immediately became the star of the team.
Found Moltres on Mt. Ember by accident and used up every Ultra Ball on it.
Spent all the Safari Zone money and refused to leave without a Kangaskhan and a Chansey.
Copied the rival's final team as best a kid could, with a friend's help for the Alakazam.
Only the cutest Pokemon get to be on this team, and that is final.
Bought a Dratini with Game Corner coins and grinded it into a Dragonite before Victory Road.
Nobody to trade with, so Haunter stays a Haunter and it is still the favourite.
Beat the League with the classic six and kept going through the Sevii Islands.
Master Ball on Mewtwo, obviously, and it still has the moves it came with.
Caught all three birds and the starter just tags along now.
Dragons are the coolest, so Dragonite, Gyarados and Charizard count and Aerodactyl is close enough.
Snorlax just refuses to die so it does most of the work.
Bred Eevees at the Four Island Daycare until every evolution was on the team.
The Lapras from Silph Co. has been the ride Pokemon since Fuchsia and now it's the star.
Caught both Nidorans on Route 22 on the very first day and never boxed them.
A friend with a link cable finally evolved everything that needed trading.
Everything new on the Sevii Islands got caught and the best ones stayed.
Everything is Electric; the Pikachu is just there because it's Pikachu.
Blaine's gym was the favourite so it's all fire, and Moltres finally joined the team.
Lorelei was the coolest Elite Four member, so this is a Lorelei team.
Same three Pokemon since 1999; why change now.
Normal types are underrated; look how much HP Snorlax has.
Traded for the other two starters so all three Kanto starters could take on the League rematch.
Koga's poison team looked cool and the Crobat came from a Golbat that just really liked him.
Mewtwo, the starter and Pikachu: everything else got boxed the moment Mewtwo was caught.
Brock's rocks were the first gym, so the whole team is rock and it took a lot of Surf to get here.
Blastoise carried the whole game and got every rare candy for it.
Rebuilt Red's Mt. Silver team and levelled all of it to 100, borrowed Espeon and the starters through a link cable.
Grinded Mewtwo, Dragonite and the starter to 100 against the Elite Four for weeks.
Everything that can Fly, all at 100, because flying is the best.
Every Eevee evolution at 100, still mad there are only five.
Four Pokemon, all 100, all the same four since Route 1.
Bulbasaur to 100 and the classic Kanto pals came along for the ride.
Dragon trainer dream team, or as close as Kanto gets.
The cutest team, grinded to 100 out of stubbornness.
Big Pokemon only; Snorlax and Lapras take turns absorbing hits and Blastoise cleans up.
One favourite from each Kanto gym, all at 100.
All the legendaries you can get without trading, plus the two big guys.
A grown-up Bug Catcher who never gave up on bugs.
Traded with a friend for the evolved trade Pokemon and then levelled everything to 100 together.
Lorelei fan, level 100 edition.
Charizard solo'd the game; the other two are just there to Fly and push boulders.
Misty was the favourite gym leader, so all water and all at 100.
The two Nidorans from the first route, and two buddies, all 100.
Normal types with Hyper Beam everywhere, because Hyper Beam is the coolest move.
Ninetales was the favourite since Pokemon Snap and it leads a team of the coolest-looking Kanto mons.
The rival's team, but done properly and at 100 to prove a point.
